description: Language-agnostic composable story building blocks for genres, roles, motivations, flaws, and relationship arcs.

composition_rules.genre_mix: Primary genre governs opening, conflict_engine, and taboos. Optional secondary genre adds scene_anchors or payoff; if rules conflict, primary taboos always win.
composition_rules.character_mix: Build each recurring character by composing 1 role_definition + 1+ motivation_engines + 1 flaw_pattern + 0..N relationship_arcs. Any role may pair with any motivation or arc.

scenario.opening: Start with a concrete technical anomaly, breach alert, subpoena, or courtroom contradiction.
scenario.conflict_engine: Technical evidence constraints + statutory deadlines + asymmetric knowledge between investigator, counsel, and suspect.
scenario.payoff: Turning raw forensic artifacts (logs, hashes, timestamps) or procedural rules into decisive courtroom leverage.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: WORM logs, SHA-256 hash manifests, NTP timestamps, Login Banners, TLS bypass lists, IR authorization forms, courtroom cross-examination benches, SOC war rooms.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never dump statute text or compliance checklists as narrator lectures; embed rules inside stakes and cross-examination.

scenario.opening: Open on an anomalous scene, rule notice, missing person, phone clue, or sudden behavior shift in a close relationship.
scenario.conflict_engine: Limited POV + escalating rule violation cost + character misjudgment.
scenario.payoff: Micro-truths uncovered, misjudgments corrected, or rules exploited to dodge danger—each answer raising a sharper threat.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Posted notices, keycard gates, phones, CCTV feeds, medical records, contracts, livestreams, identity dossiers.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never reveal answers through narrator exposition; hide clues inside physical actions.

scenario.opening: Enter mid-interrogation, dead-drop handoff, search, document transfer, or traitor tip-off.
scenario.conflict_engine: Mission objective + cover identity exposure risk + asymmetric intel; every op needs time, place, token, and exfil risk.
scenario.payoff: Verifying intel authenticity, preserving cover under pressure, or inducing enemy miscalculation at mortal stakes.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Passports/IDs, codewords, newspapers, film negatives, radio sets, cigarette packs, train stations, interrogation rooms, checkpoint patrols, dead-drop sites.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never hand intelligence to the protagonist via omniscient narration.

scenario.opening: Start with a crime scene, unknown call, reopened cold case, or workplace/police skepticism.
scenario.conflict_engine: Case deadline + relational/social pressure + information gap shifting trust and safety.
scenario.payoff: Spotting overlooked details, clearing false suspicion, and forcing peers or authorities to re-evaluate the lead.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Scene traces, surveillance clips, chat logs, old keepsakes, scents, pill bottles, medical charts, police reports, off-pattern family behavior.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never isolate puzzle-solving from the protagonist's relational stakes.

scenario.opening: Enter via a phone message, bill, commute, work snag, or minor family/neighbor friction.
scenario.conflict_engine: Concrete everyday problem + acquaintance ties + real financial or social cost.
scenario.payoff: Steady, earned improvement in livelihood, trust, or stability through tangible small wins.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Breakfast stalls, buses/subways, takeout bags, utility bills, group chats, keys, entryway shoes, wet markets, desk trinkets, shop doorbells, neighborhood greetings.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never open on pure weather/mood prose or escalate slice-of-life into power-fantasy escalation.

scenario.opening: Open on a project crisis, client pitch, office rumor, overtime clash, or promotion/contract constraint.
scenario.conflict_engine: Career deliverables + intimacy boundaries + public professional reputation.
scenario.payoff: Competence recognized publicly, mutual boundary clarity, and turning a stalled project or relationship around.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Conference rooms, cubicles, client calls, contracts, chat threads, badge-in logs, late-night takeout, promotion rosters, hotel lobbies, apartment thresholds.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never write pure project reports devoid of interpersonal tension, or pure romance detached from work stakes.

scenario.opening: Start with early collapse signs, supply shortage, shelter gate conflict, betrayal, or system failure alert.
scenario.conflict_engine: Scarce resources + trust cost + external existential threat.
scenario.payoff: Correct foresight, securing critical infrastructure/supplies, and exploiting hazard rules at real attrition cost.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Water/power meters, meds, rations, ammo, car keys, shelter airlocks, infection traces, weather alerts, base bulletins.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never grant free survival windfalls without new risk or depletion.

scenario.opening: Enter via court dispute, clan crisis, border dispatch, trial hearing, or sudden appointment/exile.
scenario.conflict_engine: Institutional hierarchy + status constraints + factional power play.
scenario.payoff: Public case reversal, turning an opponent's own decree against them, backed by documented proof and proper venue.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Official seals, court memorials, military dispatches, clan genealogies, ledgers, travel permits, interrogation tools, city gates, relay stations, court/clan seating.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never let the protagonist win purely by modern speechifying; ground moves in period authority.

scenario.opening: Show a concrete real-world predicament first, then let the anomaly immediately alter it.
scenario.conflict_engine: Conventional commonsense expectations vs. verifiable anomalous outcomes on bills, contracts, or public feeds.
scenario.payoff: Bystanders or rivals miscalculating based on normal rules while the anomaly lands on tangible reality.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Phone notifications, bills, contracts, medical checkup forms, CCTV, keycard gates, livestream chats, company group chats, family dinner tables.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never let system panels float in isolation without real-world social or financial impact.

scenario.opening: Open in a military, court, or clan crisis before introducing the anachronistic tech or info advantage.
scenario.conflict_engine: Period institutional friction + execution cost + asymmetric knowledge.
scenario.payoff: Shifting concrete power balances and exploiting institutional loopholes with layered reactions.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Sky-screen/ranking boards, workshops, military dispatches, court assemblies, city walls, granaries, academies, relay stations.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never rely solely on memorized history trivia without logistical cost.

scenario.opening: Start with an unexplained night shift incident, old object, folk rule note, or urgent plea.
scenario.conflict_engine: Unknown phenomenon + occupational compulsion to investigate + rising personal toll.
scenario.payoff: Mapping one more rule boundary, narrowly escaping a cost, or turning an entity's constraint against it.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Doorplates, chimes, old photos, incense ash, bloodstains, voice recordings, phone battery bars, folk ritual objects, dim stairwells, village rules, night roads.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never let the anomaly explain its own rules on first appearance.

scenario.opening: Open on sect discipline, master-disciple tension, trial peril, or cultivation bottleneck.
scenario.conflict_engine: Cultivation rules + sect/imperial hierarchy + moral vs. resource trade-offs.
scenario.payoff: Breakthrough earned through costly choice, sect backing, and status re-evaluation.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Sect gates, cave abodes, trial platforms, life-tablets, sword scars, pill cauldrons, talismans, spirit herbs, miasma, imperial/sect edicts.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never replace character choice and human stakes with bare technique jargon.

scenario.opening: Start with guild commission, temple trial, academy evaluation, or racial/estate friction.
scenario.conflict_engine: Institutional magic/feudal rules + identity limits + casting/contract cost.
scenario.payoff: Reversing formal evaluations, breaking prejudice, or weaponizing contract/magic costs.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Guild badges, contract scrolls, magic circles, academy assessments, tavern bounties, temple trials, castle gates, lineage/race marks.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never treat fantasy institutions as passive wallpaper; make them constrain choices.

scenario.opening: Open in motion with an immediate problem, relationship friction, or concrete stakes.
scenario.conflict_engine: Goal + resistance + irreversible cost driving the next scene's expectation.
scenario.payoff: Earned shift in leverage, knowledge, or relationship standing.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Concrete physical props, schedules, receipts, doors/thresholds, and objects carrying relational weight.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never pad scenes with static mood prose or unmotivated exposition.

scenario.opening: Enter mid-match, live raid, teammate skepticism, talent check, ranking shift, or pre-tactic decision.
scenario.conflict_engine: Clear win condition + tournament/rule constraints + opponent or bystander misjudgment.
scenario.payoff: Executing high-visibility counter-plays backed by visible stats, rankings, or live audience feedback.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Scoreboards, rankings, skill cooldowns, gear drops, arena light-boards, livestream bullet-chat, team headsets, training schedules, forum threads.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never stall with lengthy rule manuals; jump straight into tactical execution.

scenario.opening: Drop straight into a high-pressure scene—one minute before trial, breakup, or failure warning.
scenario.conflict_engine: Original plot/role pressure + mission constraints + shifting local character emotions.
scenario.payoff: Using cross-world experience to rewrite the arc and throw original antagonists off balance.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Identity tokens, relationship cards, mission objectives, countdown clocks, and immediate physical confrontation props.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never start a new world with long system exposition or let foreknowledge become an effortless win.

scenario.opening: Open on an imperial betrothal/annulment, clan interrogation, household rule trap, or identity exposure.
scenario.conflict_engine: Period hierarchy/etiquette + protagonist's anomalous edge (transmigration, system, mind-reading) + family politics.
scenario.payoff: Turning the anomaly into immediate agency that shifts power inside the household or court.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Morning greetings, clan banquets, palace gates, handkerchiefs, ledgers, marriage deeds, medicine bowls, maid messengers, reward/punishment tokens, carriage seating.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never treat period etiquette as ignorable; the anomaly must work through or against real social rules.

scenario.opening: Start with household division, ration/coupon friction, job quota, housing squeeze, or clan slight—showing what the lead lacks.
scenario.conflict_engine: Material scarcity + institutional paperwork/quotas + everyday relational debts.
scenario.payoff: Earning tangible security, reputation, and independence within the constraints of the era.

tone_and_persona.scene_anchors: Grain/cloth coupons, letters of introduction, enamel mugs, supply co-ops, tube-shaped dorms, compound courtyards, kang tables, sewing machines, job quotas, clan dinner tables.
tone_and_persona.taboos: Never dump textbook history; convey the era naturally through objects, forms, and social etiquette.

protagonist.function: Drives central book choice and carries primary reader POV stakes.
protagonist.scene_budget: Present in core scenes; must hold >= 3 plot-moving levers (authority, capital, network, background) and 3-5 sensory/voice anchors.
protagonist.exit_rule: Reaches endgame binary choice and transformed ending state.

mentor.function: Supplies early method, framing, or shelter without solving the core climax.
mentor.scene_budget: Appears at threshold transitions; steps back or exits before eclipsing the lead.
mentor.exit_rule: Plan departure, betrayal, or passing of torch explicitly.

ally.function: Shares tactical load, emotional counterweight, or complementary skill.
ally.scene_budget: Active only when their skill or relationship stake is needed.
ally.exit_rule: Define arc resolution or graceful exit when role completes.

intel_source.function: Delivers partial clues, rumors, or technical records with a price or blind spot.
intel_source.scene_budget: Brief transactional scenes; never acts as an omniscient info dispenser.
intel_source.exit_rule: Fades out once channel dries up or cover blows.

foil.function: Mirrors an alternate choice the protagonist could have made under similar pressure.
foil.scene_budget: Reappears at decision forks to sharpen thematic contrast.
foil.exit_rule: Diverges permanently after the defining choice.

sacrifice.function: Demonstrates the real mortal, moral, or institutional cost of the conflict.
sacrifice.scene_budget: Earn reader attachment via concrete shared stakes before loss.
sacrifice.exit_rule: Exit must irreversibly raise stakes or force a tactical pivot.

minor_obstacle.function: Single-unit friction with 1-2 sharp traits (greed, arrogance, bureaucratic inertia).
minor_obstacle.scene_budget: Appears only within one plot unit.
minor_obstacle.exit_rule: Defeated or exposed cleanly; exits without lingering.

volume_rival.function: Main antagonist for one volume; presses via force, authority, or resource leverage.
volume_rival.scene_budget: Wins half a beat or crushes a strong ally first to establish real pressure.
volume_rival.exit_rule: Defeated publicly at volume climax, triggering next-volume fallout.

multi_volume_boss.function: Cross-volume threat with independent goals, past origin, and ideological clash.
multi_volume_boss.scene_budget: Operates through proxies early; forces at least one high-pressure setback on the lead.
multi_volume_boss.exit_rule: Ceremonial climax showdown with lasting aftermath.

final_boss.function: Embodiment of the book's core thematic conflict; holds decisive structural advantage.
final_boss.scene_budget: Foreshadowed from early volumes or revealed at high-tier escalation.
final_boss.exit_rule: Forces the protagonist to risk their ultimate card or ceiling.

motivation_engines.emotional_debt: Driven by concrete personal debt, grief, or protection of a specific person rather than abstract ambition.
motivation_engines.survival_or_loss: Driven by immediate fear of losing status, safety, livelihood, or a cherished bond.
motivation_engines.institutional_duty: Believes they are upholding rightful order, law, or organizational survival from their own vantage.
motivation_engines.ideological_order: Acts to enforce a coherent moral, political, or philosophical worldview (never pure motiveless madness).
motivation_engines.ambition_or_status: Seeks upward mobility, recognition, or control over contested resources.

flaw_patterns.pride_in_strength: The very asset or competence the character relies on becomes their blind spot under pressure.
flaw_patterns.blind_loyalty: Over-trusts a faction, mentor, or bond, delaying recognition of betrayal or misuse.
flaw_patterns.overcontrol: Refuses to delegate or trust allies, causing bottlenecks or brittle overreach.
flaw_patterns.avoidance_of_cost: Hesitates to pay an early price, allowing a small leak to grow into a crisis.
flaw_patterns.misplaced_mercy: Spares a rival or suppresses hard evidence at the wrong moment, inviting counter-attack.

relationship_arcs.trust_ladder: Shift skepticism or hostility into loyalty across 5-7 contact inflection points (cold/formal -> discreet observation -> crisis aid -> full recognition); never flip in one chapter.
relationship_arcs.worthy_rival: Mutual recognition of competence paired with irreconcilable stance conflict.
relationship_arcs.dual_line_coupling: Career/plot line and intimate/relational line must directly cause shifts in each other.
relationship_arcs.role_reversal: Power, dependence, or pursuit polarity flips between two characters after a major turning point while staying true to original traits.
relationship_arcs.perception_gap: Exploit value/status asymmetry across public, private, ally, and rival viewpoints.
relationship_arcs.ensemble_rivalry: Redirect multi-party competition into shared crisis defense or measurable contribution contests without irreconcilable internal deadlock.

scene_discipline.speaking_cap: Limit key speaking supporting roles to 2-3 per normal scene; drop roles with zero scene function.
scene_discipline.crowd_grouping: In courts, banquets, or assemblies, rank speakers by authority and merge same-stance bystander reactions.
